m_851318d0110d.en: Red moves first. Protect your king; checkmate wins. Use drag and drop or select a piece and destination. On touch screens, confirm your preview. Promotion offers queen, rook, bishop or knight.
m_851318d0110d.zh-Hant: 紅方先行。保護自己的國王，將死對方即可獲勝。可拖曳走子，或依次選擇棋子與落點；觸控裝置先預覽再確認。升變可選皇后、城堡、主教或騎士。

m_3108a57cf466.en: Local and computer games save privately. Imported positions are checked for basic legality, not complete historical reachability. Fairy-Stockfish levels do not represent official ratings.
m_3108a57cf466.zh-Hant: 本機與人機對局使用私人存檔。匯入時僅檢查局面的基本合法性，不證明其完整歷史可達性。Fairy-Stockfish 等級不代表正式棋力評分。

m_7318f6a89302.zh-Hant: 中國象棋 · 線上戰績

m_c2a9fbd85d76.en: Xiangqi uses the same private server-verified match service as Go. Match members can read the position, moves, clocks and outcome. Standard online human games publish completed games, wins, losses, draws and win rate by time control. Local games, Fairy-Stockfish practice and imported positions remain private. Fairy-Stockfish runs on this device without sending positions to an external AI service. Unresolved and interrupted matches do not enter public statistics. Go, Xiangqi, Pong and shared Redboard share a two-active-room limit.
m_c2a9fbd85d76.zh-Hant: 中國象棋與圍棋共用私人且由伺服器驗證的對局服務。對局成員可讀取局面、步譜、時鐘與結果。標準線上真人局會按用時設定公開完局、勝、負、和及勝率；本機、Fairy-Stockfish 練習與匯入局面維持私人。Fairy-Stockfish 在此裝置執行，不會將局面傳送至外部 AI 服務。未決與中斷對局不計入公開統計。Go、Chess、Pong 與共享 Whiteboard 合計最多兩個活躍房間。

m_9fb08083729f.en: Choose a supported Xiangqi time control.
m_9fb08083729f.zh-Hant: 請選擇支援的象棋用時。

m_87ece765bf72.zh-Hant: 象棋存檔的操作紀錄無效。

m_ae37bc42ce61.zh-Hant: 標準象棋對局設定無效。

m_6554b6b6a58f.en: Online clocks continue in the background. A continuous 120-second disconnection forfeits unless time expires first. Both disconnected: interrupted. Draw offers keep the clock running.
m_6554b6b6a58f.zh-Hant: 線上時鐘在背景繼續運行。連續斷線一百二十秒判負，若時間先用完則先判超時；雙方均斷線則記為中斷。提議和棋不會暫停時鐘。

m_555543445536.en: Xiangqi rules and adjudication are independently implemented Workshop code.
m_555543445536.zh-Hant: 象棋規則與裁定由 Workshop 獨立實作。

m_965bd7d001e3.en: Xiangqi uses the same private match service. The server checks WXF moves, repetition, clocks and outcomes. Standard online human games publish wins, losses, draws and completed games by time control. Private games, imported records and computer practice do not enter public statistics. Fairy-Stockfish runs locally without sending positions to an AI service. Only Xiangqi pages and engine resources enable cross-origin isolation for the local engine.
m_965bd7d001e3.zh-Hant: 象棋沿用私有對局服務，由伺服器核對 WXF 著手、循環、時鐘與結果。標準線上真人局按用時公開勝、負、和及完局數；私人對局、匯入棋譜與人機練習不計入。Fairy-Stockfish 在本機運行，不會把局面傳給 AI 服務。只有象棋頁及引擎資源啟用本機引擎所需的跨來源隔離。

m_d6e97739d927.en: Chess uses the same private server-verified match service as Go. Match members can read the position, moves, clocks and outcome. Standard online human games publish completed games, wins, losses, draws and win rate by time control. Local games, Stockfish practice and imported positions remain private. Stockfish runs on this device without sending positions to an external AI service. Unresolved and interrupted matches do not enter public statistics. Go, Chess, Xiangqi, Pong and shared Whiteboard share a two-active-room limit.
m_d6e97739d927.zh-Hant: 西洋棋沿用圍棋的私有伺服器驗證服務，成員可讀取局面、著手、時鐘與結果。標準線上真人局按用時公開完局、勝負和與勝率。本機、Stockfish 練習和匯入局面維持私有，引擎不傳送局面至外部 AI。未決及中斷對局不計戰績。圍棋、西洋棋、象棋、Pong 與共享白板共用兩個活躍房間上限。

m_2e70a937c403.zh-Hant: 熟悉的棋盤，全新的較量。

m_3da5097c648e.zh-Hant: 熟悉的棋盤，全新的較量。支援 WXF 規則、五級人機與伺服器驗證的線上對戰。

m_e815aa5f96fb.zh-Hant: 請使用 a0–i9 座標的 ICCS 象棋文字棋譜。

m_f58333c587da.en: Import an ICCS text record, KenSei JSON record or FEN position. Imported games remain private. FEN has no previous repetition or checking history; those counters start here.
m_f58333c587da.zh-Hant: 可匯入 ICCS 文字棋譜、KenSei JSON 或 FEN 局面。匯入對局維持私人；FEN 不含先前循環與將軍歷史，相關計數從匯入後開始。

m_01c803c40da9.en: Red moves first on the standard 9 × 10 board. Protect your general; checkmate and having no legal move both lose. Select a piece and destination, drag, or use the board arrow keys and Enter. On touch screens, confirm your preview.
m_01c803c40da9.zh-Hant: 標準棋盤為九路十行，紅方先行。請保護將帥：被將死或無子可動均判負。可點選棋子與落點、拖動，或在棋盤使用方向鍵及 Enter；觸控裝置須確認預覽落點。

m_fd8814cca3d9.en: WXF 2018 rules apply. Horse legs, elephant eyes, cannon screens, river and palace restrictions are enforced. Online play has no undo, hints or single-player pause.
m_fd8814cca3d9.zh-Hant: 採用 WXF 2018 規則，檢查蹩馬腿、塞象眼、炮架、過河及九宮限制。線上對局不提供悔棋、提示或單方暫停。

m_75423af9bfb4.en: This site follows the Chinese original: after the same position returns three times, the responsible player is warned to vary. Repeating that prohibited transition loses. Lawful repetition draws after four returns. This digital referee policy is fixed for rules v1.
m_75423af9bfb4.zh-Hant: 本站以中文原文為準：同一局面返回三次後，警告責任方變著；再重複該犯例著手判負。合法循環返回四次判和。此數位裁判口徑固定於規則 v1。

m_0a17c8cdf536.en: The natural move limit is 100 qualifying plies without a capture; pawn moves do not reset it. Only a player's first ten checks count toward that player's verification total. The automatic referee verifies either player's eligible count. Checkmate and repetition forfeits take priority.
m_0a17c8cdf536.zh-Hant: 無吃子的自然限著為一百個有效著手，兵卒移動不重置。每方只有前十次將軍計入其審核計數，由自動裁判驗證任一方是否符合；將死及循環犯例判負優先。

m_3d6835146dbf.en: Private progress saves on this device first; signed-in saves sync to your account. Imported records never become ranked. Fairy-Stockfish runs on this device; its five levels are not official ratings.
m_3d6835146dbf.zh-Hant: 私人進度先儲存在此裝置，登入後同步至帳號。匯入棋譜不參加公開戰績。Fairy-Stockfish 在此裝置執行，五級難度不代表官方段位。
